for.zh: 有人靠你生活的人：在保障期間身故，一次給付保額給你指定的受益人
for.en: People someone depends on: if you die during the term, the amount goes to the people you name, in one payment

questions.zh: 生理性別（只用於死亡率表）
questions.en: Sex at birth (used only for the mortality table)

questions.zh: 過去 12 個月有抽菸（含電子菸）嗎？
questions.en: Smoked anything (e-cigarettes too) in the last 12 months?

options.en: No long-term conditions, no regular medicine

options.zh: 有控制良好的慢性病（如高血壓、氣喘）
options.en: A well-managed condition (such as high blood pressure or asthma)

options.zh: 過去 5 年有癌症、心臟病、中風或其他重大疾病
options.en: Cancer, heart disease, a stroke or another serious illness in the last 5 years

options.zh: 外勤、需要騎車或開車跑業務
options.en: Out and about, riding or driving for work

options.zh: 高處、工地、漁船、保全等高風險
options.en: Heights, construction, fishing boats, security and other high-risk work

coverages.zh: 保障期間內身故，一次給付保額
coverages.en: One payment of the amount on death within the term

coverages.zh: 末期疾病提前給付（保額的一半）
coverages.en: Half the amount early on a terminal diagnosis

decline.zh: 過去 5 年有重大疾病，線上無法核保；請改由人工核保
decline.en: A serious illness in the last 5 years can't be underwritten online; a person reviews it instead

review.zh: 45 歲以上投保 50 萬美元，需人工核保
review.en: $500,000 at 45 or older needs a person's review

clauses.zh: 「受益人」指你在保單上指定、身故時領取保險金的人，可以指定多人並分配比例，合計須為 100%。未指定或受益人已先身故者，保險金給付你的遺產。
clauses.en: A "beneficiary" is someone you name to receive the payment, several in shares adding up to 100% if you like. With none named, or if they died first, it goes to your estate.

clauses.zh: 「末期疾病」指經專科醫師診斷，依目前醫療技術無法治癒，且預期存活時間在 12 個月以內的疾病。
clauses.en: "Terminal illness" is an illness a specialist diagnoses as incurable with today's medicine, with life expected to be 12 months or less.

clauses.zh: 被保險人於保障期間內身故，我們依保額一次給付身故保險金給受益人，扣除已提前給付的末期疾病保險金。
clauses.en: If the insured person dies within the term, we pay the amount once to the beneficiaries, less any terminal illness payment made earlier.

clauses.zh: 被保險人於保障期間內經診斷為末期疾病，得申請提前給付保額的 50%；提前給付後，保單其餘部分繼續有效。
clauses.en: If the insured person is diagnosed with a terminal illness within the term, they may claim 50% of the amount early; the rest of the policy stays in force.

clauses.zh: 保單生效或復效後 2 年內自殺，不予理賠，退還已繳保費。
clauses.en: No payment for suicide within 2 years of the policy starting or being reinstated; the premiums paid are refunded.

clauses.zh: 受益人故意致被保險人於死，該受益人喪失受益權。戰爭或被保險人犯罪被處死刑，不予理賠。
clauses.en: A beneficiary who caused the death on purpose loses their share. No payment for death in war or by execution for a crime.

clauses.zh: 投保時應據實告知健康問卷。保單生效 2 年內，如發現未據實告知且影響核保，我們得解除契約；超過 2 年不再解除（不可抗辯條款）。
clauses.en: Answer the health questions truthfully. Within 2 years of the start, a false answer that would have changed our decision lets us rescind the policy; after 2 years we can't (the incontestability clause).

clauses.zh: 申請身故保險金須提供經認證的死亡證明書及受益人身分證明。所有壽險理賠皆由人工審核，不自動給付。
clauses.en: A death claim needs a certified death certificate and the beneficiary's ID. Every life claim is reviewed by a person; none is paid automatically.

clauses.zh: 你可以隨時變更受益人，或在保障期間內調降保額，調降後立即重新計價並退還差額；調高保額須重新核保。
clauses.en: Change beneficiaries any time, or lower the amount within the term, priced again at once with the difference refunded; raising it needs new underwriting.

clauses.zh: 保費月繳或年繳；月繳扣款失敗有 30 日寬限期，逾期停效，2 年內可申請復效（須重新告知健康狀況）。可隨時退保，按未經過日數退費。保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池；年度結算後剩餘捐給你選的公益團體。
clauses.en: Pay monthly or yearly; a failed payment has 30 days' grace, then the policy lapses and can be reinstated within 2 years (with the health questions again). Cancel any time for a refund of the days left. 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee, the rest the claims pool; what is left after the year goes to your chosen cause.
